setting: All five work on the same general medical ward of a city hospital in Osaka, and they text each other about shifts, handovers and ward gossip. Most of them have worked together for several years, and they know each other's usual shifts, families and which of them is good at covering for whom. Haruka's lunch bento was left in the staff fridge last week, and the group has been teasing whoever took it.
opener: Ask who can cover the late shift tomorrow after Yuka rang in sick.

Aiko.who: 34, woman, the staff nurse who usually sets up the rota swaps
Aiko.knows: You know Kenji is the charge nurse you report to and has been on the ward longest. You know Yuka is the newest junior nurse and you have been showing her the drug round. You know Daisuke is the healthcare assistant who is good with the older patients and always brings snacks. You know Haruka is the ward clerk who keeps the rota and phone list.
Aiko.like: You are organised, a bit dry, and you laugh at yourself more than others. You care about getting handovers right and you tease Daisuke about his snacks, while you look out for Yuka and sometimes get annoyed at Kenji for changing plans at the last minute.
Aiko.texts: You message in the group now and then, mostly when something about the rota needs sorting.
Aiko.style: You type in short lines with normal capitals, few emoji, and a full stop at the end of most messages.

Kenji.who: 52, man, the charge nurse in charge of the ward
Kenji.knows: You know Aiko is your most dependable staff nurse and the one you rely on for the difficult patients. You know Yuka is new and you have asked Aiko to keep an eye on her. You know Daisuke has a daughter at school and sometimes leaves early for her events. You know Haruka keeps the phone list and you have never once managed to beat her at the lunch rota.
Kenji.like: You are steady, patient and quietly funny, and you like a good cup of green tea. You get enthusiastic about model trains and tease Haruka about the lunch rota, and you get on well with Aiko but sometimes wish Daisuke would be more punctual.
Kenji.texts: You message in the group now and then, mostly to confirm cover or to tell everyone about a meeting.
Kenji.style: You type in full sentences with proper capitals and punctuation, and you rarely use emoji.

Yuka.who: 27, woman, the newest junior nurse on the ward
Yuka.knows: You know Aiko is the staff nurse who has been teaching you the drug round and has been patient with your questions. You know Kenji is the charge nurse who signs off your competencies. You know Daisuke is the healthcare assistant who helped you on your first night shift. You know Haruka is the ward clerk who always seems to know where everything is.
Yuka.like: You are keen, a bit anxious, and a good listener, with a quick, gentle sense of humour. You get enthusiastic about cooking and you are looking forward to the weekend, and you get on well with Aiko but sometimes feel shy around Kenji.
Yuka.texts: You message in the group now and then, mostly to ask a question or to check who is on a shift.
Yuka.style: You type in fairly short messages with ordinary capitals and occasional emoji, and you often add a question mark.

Daisuke.who: 41, man, the healthcare assistant on the ward
Daisuke.knows: You know Aiko is the staff nurse you work most shifts with and you bring her snacks when she is on a long day. You know Kenji is the charge nurse who always gives you the early shifts because of your daughter's school schedule. You know Yuka is the new junior nurse whom you helped on her first night. You know Haruka is the ward clerk who keeps the phone list and has an excellent memory for birthdays.
Daisuke.like: You are warm, cheerful and a little bit chaotic, and you love a bit of teasing. You get enthusiastic about football and you like to bring snacks for the team, and you get on well with everyone but sometimes wind up Yuka by mixing up the handover details.
Daisuke.texts: You message in the group now and then, mostly to offer or ask for a swap or to share something funny.
Daisuke.style: You type in casual messages with lots of exclamation marks and the odd emoji, and you often write in short bursts.

Haruka.who: 60, woman, the ward clerk who manages the rota and phone list
Haruka.knows: You know Aiko is the staff nurse who always gets the rota sorted quickly and who does not mind your long-winded emails. You know Kenji is the charge nurse who has never beaten you at the lunch rota and whom you have been teasing for years. You know Yuka is the new junior nurse whom you try to make feel welcome. You know Daisuke is the healthcare assistant who always brings snacks and whose daughter you have watched grow up.
Haruka.like: You are methodical, warm and a little bossy, with a dry sense of humour. You get enthusiastic about gardening and sharing recipes, and you tease Kenji about the lunch rota, while you look out for Yuka and sometimes find Daisuke's disorganisation hard to bear.
Haruka.texts: You message in the group now and then, mostly to remind people about the rota or to share a useful update.
Haruka.style: You type in complete sentences with proper punctuation and the occasional smiley face, and your messages are often longer than the others'.

private_lines.Aiko: You live in Osaka with your partner and a cat, about twenty minutes from the hospital by train. You work three long days and two short ones, and this week you are on the late shift for most of it. You are trying to finish a course on wound care online in the evenings and have a dentist appointment on Thursday.
private_lines.Kenji: You live in Kobe with your wife and commute to Osaka by train, which takes about forty minutes. You are the charge nurse on a rotating schedule, which means managing staffing and sitting in meetings. This week you have a meeting with the hospital managers about winter bed pressure and you are juggling two staff absences.
private_lines.Yuka: You live in Osaka in a small flat with a flatmate, about fifteen minutes from the hospital by bike. You work full shifts and this week you are on nights, which has left you tired. You are also trying to learn the ward's IV procedures and you have a friend's birthday on Saturday.
private_lines.Daisuke: You live in Osaka with your wife and daughter, about thirty minutes from the hospital by bus. You work as a healthcare assistant on the day shift, helping patients with washing, meals and mobility. This week your daughter has a school sports day on Thursday, so you have swapped a shift and are planning to leave early.
private_lines.Haruka: You live in Osaka with your husband, about twenty-five minutes from the hospital by train. You work weekday office hours as the ward clerk, handling the rota, the phone list and admin. This week you are preparing the rota for December, which is always a headache, and you are looking forward to a weekend trip to see your sister.

text: Yuka's rung in sick for tomorrow's late. Anyone free 14:00 to 22:00?
I can't do the late, I'm at the managers' meeting until 17:30. Haruka, can you see who's on the bank list?
Daisuke, are you on tomorrow?
I'm on days tomorrow!! I can do till 15:00 then I have to go, sorry!!
I have the bank list open. Two agency names, neither has replied yet. I'll try again in the morning if nothing by then. Aiko, can you do a double?
I'm already on the late tomorrow. Need a second staff nurse, not just a HCA.
Yuka was on nights this week so she'll be wiped anyway. I'll ask Mori from the other ward. Haruka, could you ring the bank again at 08:00?
Of course. Kenji, it's still your turn to replace the bento, I haven't forgotten.
lol the bento!! Haruka it wasn't me i swear 😂
It was Daisuke. He had a face on him all Thursday.
ISN'T PROVEN!!
Mori says she can't, she has her own late. Kenji, shall I text Sato from rehab?
Yes please. Can I have the reply in writing?
Sorry I'm not around much, I saw the messages. Feel terrible for leaving you short. Hopefully back Weds?
Don't worry about it. Rest.
Get well, Yuka. Come back when you're properly ready.
Sato says she can do 14:00 to 22:00 if the ward confirms before noon. I'll ring the ward manager.
Thank you Haruka. Aiko, can you confirm with her at handover tomorrow?
Will do.
morning!! anyone know if the vending machine on 4 is fixed
Still broken. Use the one by the lift.
ugh ok!!!
Good morning all. Ward manager has confirmed Sato for the late, 14:00 to 22:00. I'll update the board.
thank you haruka!! you're the best!!!
I know. Please do not forget the handover sheet this time.
Thank you, Haruka. Aiko, Sato's handover from rehab is at 13:30?
Yes. I'll meet her at the desk.
Feeling much better! Can I come in Weds? I need to make up the IV competency
Yes, if you feel well. Come to my office at 08:00 and we'll check your sheet.
Thank you! 🙂
Heading off early today, see you all!! Aiko save me some cake
There's no cake.
THERE'S ALWAYS CAKE
December rota is nearly done. I'll circulate the draft on Thursday, please check your leave dates before it goes to Kenji. Apologies in advance for the emails.
Your emails are never a problem.
That is very kind. 🙂
Sato's confirmed for tomorrow. I'll have the handover sheet ready before she comes up.
you're a legend aiko!!
Haruka, did the agency reply?
Neither agency has replied. I'll try again at 08:00 as Kenji asked. Kenji, your managers' meeting minutes are in the shared folder if you want them before tomorrow.
Thank you. I'll read them on the train.
Quick one, does anyone know if the IV pump on bay 3 is the new model or the old one? Trying to learn the settings before Weds
Old one. The new ones are in the store room on 4. I'll show you on Weds if you want, before your sheet with Kenji.
That would be great, thank you 🙂
can someone tell me what time sports day starts tomorrow? i'm supposed to be leaving early and i'm sure i've got it wrong
You told me last week it starts at 13:30, Daisuke. I have it written down.
ah thank you!! you're a lifesaver
Morning. Haruka, can you confirm the bed meeting is still at 10:00?
Confirmed for 10:00 in the small room. Good morning Kenji.
Morning. Sato's at the desk early, she's already read the sheet.
I'm on my way to Kenji's office now, will be a few minutes late 😅
Take your time.
Ward manager asks whether the December draft will need an extra late on the 14th. Aiko, you're down for two lates that week, is that right?
Yes, and I've swapped one with Mori. Check the board before you send the draft.
I have checked the board. Twice.
has anyone seen my keys?? i left them somewhere on 4
Lost property has a box by the lift.
found them!! they were in the bento fridge 😂
I beg your pardon?
just joking!! the keys were in my pocket the whole time
Haruka, I believe that is the closest anyone has come to confessing.
Kenji, the bento was not a confession. It was a theft, and you are still in my debt.
Competency signed off! Thank you Kenji and Aiko. Feel much better about the pumps now
Good. Well done.
Well done, Yuka. Your sheet is in the folder.
Thank you 🙂
off now!! sports day, wish me luck
Good luck to your daughter, not you.
ok that's fair
The December draft is with Kenji for approval. Please check your leave dates if anything has changed since Tuesday.
Approved subject to the 14th. Aiko, can you swap with someone for that late?
I'll try Mori again tomorrow. Not tonight.
Going home to sleep. Night shift tonight is cancelled? Need to know whether I'm on or not
You are not on nights this week, Yuka. Your shift on Thursday is a day shift at 08:00. The board is correct.
